record.question:
In the pre-colonial Mizo socio-ethical structure, who among the following was selected by the Chief
    specifically for their expertise in jhum cultivation, possessed the ability to choose good cultivation
    land, and functioned in a capacity akin to a modern-day “agriculture minister”?
